# Noto font notice

The bundled Noto Sans variable fonts are copied from the official Google Fonts
repository at commit `389b770410cc0b7c21c85673bfa2077420fe7f65`.

They are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The unmodified
license text is included as `OFL.txt`. The fonts are used locally for bounded
HarfBuzz shaping, glyph-coverage inspection and preview paths; they are not
silently installed into the operating system.
